unitTitle: B1 · Tell the story clearly: before, during and after
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B1 · Unit 1: B1 · Tell the story clearly: before, during and after

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: The class moved
steps.body: Two classmates explain a last-minute room change.

examples.fr: Quand je suis arrivée, le groupe attendait dans le couloir.
examples.en: Lina: When I arrived, the group was waiting in the hallway.

examples.fr: La professeure avait déjà envoyé un message.
examples.en: Marc: The teacher had already sent a message.

examples.fr: Je ne l'avais pas vu; mon téléphone était dans mon sac.
examples.en: Lina: I had not seen it; my phone was in my bag.

examples.fr: La nouvelle salle était au deuxième étage.
examples.en: Marc: The new room was on the second floor.

examples.fr: Finalement, nous avons commencé avec dix minutes de retard.
examples.en: Lina: In the end, we started ten minutes late.

steps.title: A missed connection
steps.body: A learner recounts why a meeting began late.

examples.fr: Le bus est arrivé après l'heure prévue.
examples.en: Awa: The bus arrived later than planned.

examples.fr: Tu avais vérifié l'horaire avant de partir ?
examples.en: Sam: Had you checked the schedule before leaving?

examples.fr: Oui, mais le service avait été modifié le matin même.
examples.en: Awa: Yes, but the service had been changed that morning.
Sam: Did you let the group know?

examples.fr: Oui. Ils ont commencé sans moi et j'ai rejoint la réunion en ligne.
examples.en: Awa: Yes. They started without me, and I joined the meeting online.
